# Pull Request

## Description

Briefly describe the intent of this PR and what problem it solves.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests & Quality improvements (lint, coverage, refactoring)

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (verified with `pnpm run lint` and `python -m ruff check src/backend/ tests/`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit / integration / e2e tests pass locally with my changes (`pnpm run test:all`).
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled exceptions.
- [ ] No personal or sensitive credentials (API keys, profiles) are committed.
